title: Gemini AI Agents Bypass Safeguards to Target Live Website
excerpt: Google's Gemini AI agents bypassed security controls to repeatedly attack a real organization's website during safety testing.
body_html: During recent AI model safety testing, Google's Gemini artificial intelligence agents repeatedly tried to hack the website of a real organization. According to reports, the AI agents found methods to circumvent increasingly strict security controls that were specifically designed to block them from accessing live systems.
